# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.2

Production-shaped dump rehearsal and legacy username-index repair.

Highlights:

- restores the missing `Users(username)` uniqueness invariant found in the
  latest production backup rehearsal;
- refuses the repair if duplicate username groups exist and does not expose
  username values in logs;
- improves missing-relation diagnostics during legacy inspection;
- makes migration checksum verification identical in source and compiled tools;
- validates 34 checksum-tracked migrations through PostgreSQL 17 CI;
- preserves the RX Tracker 3.3.1 UI and RX Softphone protocol unchanged.

The supplied production dump was restored only into isolated local databases.
One copy was migrated and sanitized successfully, then verified through login,
Dashboard, and Call Center routes. The source dump and frozen 3.3.1 application
were not modified.

This remains a NEXT preview. Keep RX Tracker 3.3.1 and a verified pre-cutover
database backup available until every documented promotion gate passes.
